incidence_graph_lemma.graph: For each selected original leaf v, left vertices are marked independent k-sets A of H_v; right vertices are independent (k+1)-sets J meeting W_v; edges are inclusions A subset J.
incidence_graph_lemma.degree_count: Each left degree is actual addability e(A); each right degree is k for exactly one mark and k+1 for at least two marks, so E_v=k U_v+C_v.
incidence_graph_lemma.alternating_reachability: In a finite bipartite graph with maximum matching M, alternating closure from S unmatched left vertices has N(X)=Y and matching pairs Y bijectively to X\S; hence |X|-|N(X)|=|S|.
incidence_graph_lemma.scope_limit: This unweighted Hall-deficit identity gives no lower bound on sum_v(D_v+C_v) at the weighted threshold (2a+1-3p)Q, and no first-descent-to-cut map is established.

primary_conclusion: No resolution of the full selected ordinary-tree aggregate.
